briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 multi-agent rollout escalates AGI race as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI frontier intensifies with new model releases from OpenAI and DeepSeek while compute constraints bite. Global funding surges past $14B this quarter amid regulatory scrutiny. Prompt injection threats persist across deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with native multi-agent orchestration; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus. DeepSeek-V4 matches GPT-5 on benchmarks at lower cost. Meta open-sources Llama 4.1 weights.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target agentic systems.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell clusters ramp at xAI Memphis site. Google TPU v6 enters production with 40% efficiency gains. Microsoft adds 50k H100s in Ireland for OpenAI workloads.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems achieve autonomous R&D before 2028?
